svg.aria-label: UI architecture: customer chat, demo stage and agent console in the browser → Next.js BFF on Amplify Hosting → identity service, AgentCore Runtime and DynamoDB (sessions, conversation_messages, handoffs, decision_records) → DynamoDB Streams → realtime-publisher Lambda → AppSync Events channels pushed back to the browsers over WebSocket. Animated: sign-in, a turn and its trace reveal, an unauthorized-charge handoff reaching the agent queue, a human takeover, and a customer message that skips the runtime.
svg.text: WebSocket · AppSync Events · subscribe-only realtime token · onSubscribe checks channel vs claims
route handlers = BFF · Zod in · role check first
· clients: fetch after cursor, then listen
· no AWS credentials in the browser
· history read only after owner check
① Sign in: /api/auth → identity service → 15-min JWT in an httpOnly cookie + subscribe-only realtime token
② /api/chat → AgentCore (Bearer JWT · runtime session id · message id) → graph writes messages + decision_records
reply returns to the phone: «Tu tarjeta •••• 3381 tiene USD 1,240.50 disponibles»
③ decision_records Stream → publisher → /trace/<sid> → demo stage lights Understand·Decide·Act·Verify, then reveals the trace
④ «No reconozco un cargo de $420 en Amazon» → Jev reports_unauthorized_use 0.88 ≥ 0.50 → handoff.v1 written
⑤ handoffs Stream → publisher → /queue → agent console: HND-7Q2K · critical (live, no refresh)
⑥ Take over: TransactWriteItems (sessions.control = human + handoffs.in_takeover) → /session/<sid> → «Ana se unió»
⑦ Customer replies: control = human → BFF stores the message, AgentCore not called → pushed to the agent's Conversation tab
